description:
You are a paralegal preparing a legal memorandum for filing. The document at /home/ga/Documents/legal_memo_draft.docx is a memorandum of law analyzing contract damages. It contains six inline case citations in square brackets (e.g., '[See Hadley v. Baxendale...]') that need to be converted into proper footnotes.

Perform the following tasks:

1. CONVERT INLINE CITATIONS TO FOOTNOTES: For each of the six bracketed citations in the document body, delete the bracketed text and insert a footnote in its place (Insert > Footnote and Endnote > Footnote). The footnote text should contain the citation (without the outer square brackets). The six citations reference these cases: Hadley v. Baxendale, Jacob & Youngs v. Kent, Groves v. John Wunder Co., Peevyhouse v. Garland Coal & Mining Co., Sullivan v. O'Connor, and Hawkins v. McGee.

2. REFORMAT THE DOCUMENT to legal brief standards:
   a. Change all body text font to Liberation Serif (or Times New Roman) at 12pt
   b. Set line spacing to Double for body paragraphs
   c. Set all page margins (top, bottom, left, right) to 1.0 inch
   d. Center the title 'MEMORANDUM OF LAW' and make it bold

3. SAVE the formatted document as: /home/ga/Documents/legal_memo_formatted.docx

Do NOT modify the original draft file. Use Save As to create the new file in DOCX format.
